issues: business-category-suggestion renders 'Suggestion IA : PNEUS · 99 %' (uppercase code) rather than the human label 'Pneus' as specified in the review request. Cosmetic — code label is used instead of localized label. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: BusinessCategoryPicker business-category-suggestion shows the category CODE (e.g. 'PNEUS') while elsewhere the Select uses the French label ('Pneus'). Consider rendering the human label (c.label) for consistency with doc-edit-business-category and cost-category.

ScanDocumentDialog goes through a mandatory DocumentCropper (recadrage) step before scan-analyze-btn becomes visible. The 'Valider le recadrage' button has no data-testid, which breaks automated test flows if the review step is to be reached deterministically.

ScanDocumentDialog upload creates a new document with a generated name (scan-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.pdf) rather than the original filename, so a UI filter by 'facture_pneus_test' misses the newly-scanned doc. Non-blocking but may confuse users searching for their original file.
Minor: Recharts width/height(-1) warnings on Dashboard & /couts cost charts before container is measured — pre-existing cosmetic warnings only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 flows; one sub-check N/A for RBAC-review since no analyzed doc exists in client-test-e2e tenant)
